name: Medial
description: Towards the midline of the body

name: Lateral
description: Away from the midline of the body

name: Contralateral
description: On the opposite side of the body

name: Ipsilateral
description: On the same side of the body

name: Anterior
description: Toward the front of the body

name: Posterior
description: Toward the back of the body

name: Superior
description: Above or higher in position

name: Inferior
description: Below or lower in position

name: Dexter
description: Right side of the body

name: Sinister
description: Left side of the body

name: Cranial
description: Towards the head (within trunk/torso)

name: Caudal
description: Towards the tail or feet (within trunk/torso)

name: Ventral
description: Toward the belly/front (within trunk/torso)

name: Dorsal
description: Toward the back/spine (within trunk/torso)

name: Proximal
description: Closer to the trunk or point of origin (within limbs)

name: Distal
description: Farther from the trunk or point of origin (within limbs)

name: Palmar
description: Pertaining to the palm of the hand

name: Plantar
description: Pertaining to the sole of the foot

name: Ulnar
description: Toward the ulna (inner side of forearm)

name: Radial
description: Toward the radius (outer side of forearm)

name: Dorsal (extremities)
description: Back of hand or top of foot
